infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: VisionGuide requires continuous camera access to detect obstacles, stairs, wet floor signs, and room plaques in real time.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: VisionGuide uses the microphone for Push-to-Talk voice destination commands.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: VisionGuide uses your GPS location to provide turn-by-turn outdoor walking navigation to building entrances.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow VisionGuide to use your camera for obstacle detection and indoor room sign reading.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow VisionGuide to access your GPS location for outdoor walking navigation.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow VisionGuide to access your microphone for Push-to-Talk voice commands.
